{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"Economy includes 23 kg and Business includes 32 kg for one bag. Gold adds 5 kg, and International adds 2 kg. The fee is $15 per kg over your allowance, or $0 at or below it."},{"type":"ui","source":"root = Stack([cabin, status, route, weight, allowance, fee])
$cabin = 0
$gold = 0
$route = 0
$weight = 23
cabin = Control("Cabin", 0, 1, ["Economy", "Business"], $cabin)
status = Control("Gold status", 0, 1, ["No Gold", "Gold"], $gold)
route = Control("Route", 0, 1, ["Domestic", "International"], $route)
weight = Control("Bag weight (kg)", 10, 40, [], $weight)
base = $cabin == 0 ? 23 : 32
allowed = base + $gold * 5 + $route * 2
excess = $weight > allowed ? $weight - allowed : 0
allowance = Metric("Bag allowance (kg)", allowed)
fee = Metric("Single-bag fee ($)", excess * 15)","state":[{"name":"cabin","value":0},{"name":"gold","value":1},{"name":"route","value":0},{"name":"weight","value":38}]}]}
